title: Item Three: Decorative Accent
summary: Emergency HOA meeting. The purple driveway light is tabled as a decorative accent. Brad has swatches. Biscuit steals the gavel. Pizza Guy at the door.
visualArc: Fluorescent clubhouse → cracked gavel → violet blinds → rift through the window → pizza in the doorway.
